ciws.title: File:Sailors fire Phalanx close-in weapons system 140905-N-GW918-003.jpg
ciws.description:
Fire Controlman 2nd Class Matthew Degraff, from Colorado Springs, Colo., awaits the order to fire the Phalanx close-in weapons system board guided-missile cruiser USS Bunker Hill (CG 52). Bunker Hill is underway in the 7th Fleet area of responsibility as part of the Carl Vinson Carrier Strike supporting security and stability in the Indo-Asia-Pacific region. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class LaTunya Howard/Released)
  Unit: Commander, U.S. 7th Fleet Public Affairs
